Description: Include per-file metrics and corpus benchmark details in /api/admin/ml-model
Instruction: Update get_ml_status to also compute and return document-level statistics (total submissions, words, exact/semantic breakdown, outlier status) and benchmark distribution metrics for the ML Statistics tab.
ReplacementContent:
@app.get("/api/admin/ml-model")
def get_ml_status(db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    """Admin-only endpoint: Exposes fine-tuned model statistics, weights, per-file metrics, and institutional benchmarks."""
    submissions = db.query(Submission).order_by(Submission.created_at.desc()).all()
    reports = db.query(ComparisonReport).all()

    # Calculate per-file metrics
    file_stats = []
    all_scores = [r.overall_similarity for r in reports] if reports else [0.0]
    corpus_avg = float(sum(all_scores) / max(len(all_scores), 1))
    
    for s in submissions:
        # Find comparisons involving this file
        related_reports = [r for r in reports if r.doc_a_id == s.id or r.doc_b_id == s.id or r.doc_a_title == s.title or r.doc_b_title == s.title]
        max_sim = max([r.overall_similarity for r in related_reports], default=0.0)
        avg_sim = sum([r.overall_similarity for r in related_reports]) / len(related_reports) if related_reports else 0.0
        exact_sim = max([r.exact_similarity for r in related_reports], default=0.0)
        semantic_sim = max([r.semantic_similarity for r in related_reports], default=0.0)
        
        words = len((s.content or "").split())
        chars = len(s.content or "")
        
        file_stats.append({
            "id": s.id,
            "title": s.title,
            "author": s.author,
            "status": s.status or "Under Review",
            "word_count": words,
            "char_count": chars,
            "comparisons_count": len(related_reports),
            "max_similarity": round(max_sim, 1),
            "avg_similarity": round(avg_sim, 1),
            "max_exact_overlap": round(exact_sim, 1),
            "max_semantic_overlap": round(semantic_sim, 1),
            "is_above_corpus_avg": max_sim > corpus_avg and max_sim >= 15.0,
            "created_at": s.created_at.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") if s.created_at else ""
        })

    # Benchmark statistics
    benchmark = {
        "total_documents": len(submissions),
        "total_comparisons": len(reports),
        "corpus_mean_similarity": round(corpus_avg, 2),
        "corpus_variance": round(sum((sc - corpus_avg)**2 for sc in all_scores) / max(len(all_scores), 1), 2),
        "flagged_pairs_count": sum(1 for r in reports if r.overall_similarity > corpus_avg and r.overall_similarity >= 15.0),
        "anti_common_word_filter_active": True,
        "learned_discount_tokens": len(ml_model.data.get("learned_stopwords", []))
    }

    return {
        "weights": ml_model.data["weights"],
        "calibration_bias": ml_model.data["calibration_bias"],
        "total_feedback_samples": ml_model.data["total_feedback_samples"],
        "version": ml_model.data["version"],
        "learned_stopwords": ml_model.data["learned_stopwords"],
        "recent_updates": ml_model.data.get("recent_updates", []),
        "file_statistics": file_stats,
        "benchmark": benchmark
    }
